source: Your interpreter will join by video before registration begins.
hypothesis: Su intérprete se conectará por video antes de que comience la inscripción.
reference_rationale: Role, channel and temporal order are preserved.

source: You do not need to bring printed documents.
hypothesis: No necesita traer documentos impresos.
reference_rationale: Negation is correctly preserved.

source: The label reads 12 milligrams per capsule.
hypothesis: La etiqueta indica 12 miligramos por cápsula.
reference_rationale: Quantity, unit and denominator are preserved.

source: Please remain on the line while I connect the interpreter.
hypothesis: Por favor, permanezca en la línea mientras conecto al intérprete.
reference_rationale: The instruction and simultaneous condition are preserved.

source: Do not inject the medicine if the liquid is cloudy.
hypothesis: Inyecte el medicamento si el líquido está turbio.
reference_rationale: A prohibited injection becomes an affirmative clinical action.

source: No signature is required for the parking voucher.
hypothesis: Se requiere una firma para el vale de estacionamiento.
reference_rationale: The administrative requirement is reversed; no clinical action is stated.

source: Do not give this medicine to a child who has had an allergic reaction to it.
hypothesis: Dé este medicamento a un niño que haya tenido una reacción alérgica a él.
reference_rationale: A stated medication prohibition is reversed.

source: The interpreter cannot see the document on your screen.
hypothesis: El intérprete puede ver el documento en su pantalla.
reference_rationale: Access to a document is reversed; no clinical action is stated.

source: Administer 0.4 mL from the marked syringe.
hypothesis: Administre 4 mL con la jeringa marcada.
reference_rationale: The quantity in an explicit administration instruction changes tenfold.

source: The room number for your interview is 206.
hypothesis: El número de sala para su entrevista es 260.
reference_rationale: The administrative location changes.

source: The oxygen flow on the order is 2 liters per minute.
hypothesis: El flujo de oxígeno en la orden es de 20 litros por minuto.
reference_rationale: The flow specified by a clinical order changes tenfold.

source: Your reference number ends in 71.
hypothesis: Su número de referencia termina en 17.
reference_rationale: The identifier changes without a stated clinical instruction.

source: Use the inhaler, not the nasal spray, for this prescribed dose.
hypothesis: Use el aerosol nasal, no el inhalador, para esta dosis recetada.
reference_rationale: Two device names are exchanged in an explicit administration instruction.

source: The attached document is the consent form.
hypothesis: El documento adjunto es la factura.
reference_rationale: The document type changes; no immediate clinical action is stated.

source: This bottle contains insulin for the scheduled injection.
hypothesis: Este frasco contiene heparina para la inyección programada.
reference_rationale: The named drug in an injection context is replaced.

source: A certified interpreter will translate the meeting.
hypothesis: Un recepcionista certificado interpretará la reunión.
reference_rationale: The professional role is replaced.

source: Give the next dose only after the clinician confirms the laboratory result.
hypothesis: Administre la siguiente dosis.
reference_rationale: A prerequisite to administering a dose is removed.

source: Bring the signed application and the original identity document.
hypothesis: Traiga la solicitud firmada.
reference_rationale: A required document is omitted.

source: Start the transfusion only after the identity check is complete.
hypothesis: Inicie la transfusión.
reference_rationale: A prerequisite to a clinical action is removed.

source: The interpreter is available on weekdays from noon until four.
hypothesis: El intérprete está disponible los días laborables.
reference_rationale: The availability interval is omitted.

source: The appointment was postponed to a later date.
hypothesis: La cita se adelantó a una fecha anterior.
reference_rationale: The direction of rescheduling is reversed without an explicit negation or number change.

source: Reduce the infusion rate according to the written order.
hypothesis: Aumente la velocidad de infusión según la orden escrita.
reference_rationale: The clinical action verb is reversed; this is not an added or dropped negation token.

source: The office will contact you after reviewing the form.
hypothesis: La oficina se comunicará con usted mañana después de revisar el formulario.
reference_rationale: An unsupported date commitment is added.

source: The interpreter is ready to begin.
hypothesis: El intérprete están listo para comenzar.
reference_rationale: Subject-verb agreement is faulty; the proposition remains clear.
